title: UI variant matrix (v0)
description: One file per wrapper at apps/storefront/src/ui/<name>/matrix.json. The gallery route /[locale]/ui-lab/<name> renders every case inside a container carrying data-case="<viewport>/<id>"; the generic Playwright runner measures each case one dimension at a time and compares against golden.json. Cases are JSON only: a case IS a proto JSON-UI node, so the matrix doubles as the first corpus for phase 3. Architect, 2026-09-06.

viewports.description: Default pair: desktop 1280×800 and mobile 375×812. RTL viewport (dir: rtl) is mandatory for any component with horizontal layout, because ar and he are live locales.

excluded.description: Cartesian-product combinations deliberately not covered, each with a reason (e.g. loading × disabled is the same rendering). The completeness check counts variants × states minus these.

use.description: Root name or dotted subcomponent (Select, Select.Trigger, Icon).

covers.description: Which variant values and states this case covers (variant: primary, size: base, state: hover). Used by the completeness check against contract.json.

active.description: mouse down held on the target

keys.description: Key presses in order after focus (ArrowDown, Enter, Escape…).

waitFor.description: CSS selector that must be visible before measuring (portal content).

target.description: CSS selector inside the case container (or document for portals) to measure. Default: first element child of the container.

measure.description: Dimensions to record and compare, each independently. `screenshot` stores a PNG as evidence and is compared only when the case asks for it.
